title: [21/7/2023] Internet usage in Taiwan by age group
prompt: The graph shows Internet usage in Taiwan by Age Group, 1998-2000. Summarize the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The bar chart illustrates the percentage of people using the Internet across different age groups in Taiwan over a three-year period from 1998 to 2000.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: Overall, while Internet usage among those under 15 years old and those aged 50 or above showed an upward trend throughout the period, the figures for users within the 16-30 and 31-50 age brackets declined gradually. Additionally, the 16-30 age group consistently accounted for the highest proportion of Internet users over the period shown.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: Looking at the two dominant age groups, in 1998, 16-to-30-year-olds accounted for 53% of the Internet users in Taiwan, compared to approximately 41% of those aged 31-50. Thereafter, the younger group's figures declined slightly over the next two years, reaching about 44% by 2000. Similarly, the proportion of Internet users aged 31-50 also decreased gradually, falling to roughly 37% at the end of the period.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: Regarding the remaining age brackets, only about 2% of Internet users were children under 15 in 1998, while the figure for those aged 50 and above stood at 4%. The former group saw the most dramatic increase, rising to nearly 9% by 2000, while Internet usage among older adults showed a more modest rise, reaching approximately 10% in the final year.
